Title: Senior Data Scientist ID70128
Description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. About The Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build machine learning algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified dashboards that drive adoption of data-driven security governance. MUST HAVES 6+ years of commercial Data Science experience with the ability to operate autonomously and independently; Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL; Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch; Experience with data visualization and reporting tools; Prior commercial experience applying Data Science to cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or financial risk models; Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills; Upper-intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) platforms and data outputs, such as Wiz. Perks And Benefits Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive compensation. Exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients, including Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands. Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, with options for remote work and flexible hours.

This role includes business analysis skills with hands-on solution development, ensuring that AI opportunities are translated into practical, secure, and scalable solutions. The scope of work includes requirements gathering, prototyping, integration, and deployment of AI-enabled applications using Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services (including Azure AI Foundry/Studio, Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI), and other emerging tools. Through close collaboration with IT, PLM, and Business Systems teams, the AI Systems Analyst will help embed AI capabilities into core business processes. Job Description Identify, evaluate, and help prioritize AI and automation use cases. Collect and translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs. Build, configure, and deploy AI-enabled applications and workflows using Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry/Studio, and Cognitive Services. Develop scripts, connectors, and API integrations to extend platform functionality where required. Prototype and implement AI solutions such as chatbots, copilots, document intelligence, predictive analytics, and generative AI use cases. Collaborate with IT and enterprise system owners to integrate AI solutions into existing platforms and processes. Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with enterprise governance standards. Provide training, documentation, and knowledge transfer to business users to drive adoption. Monitor solution performance and refine based on user feedback and evolving business needs. Contribute to the ongoing development of the enterprise AI technology roadmap and best practices. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is required. Minimum 5 years of experience in business systems analysis, solution development, or enterprise application integration. Proven ability to gather requirements, map processes, and translate them into functional AI-enabled solutions. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft Teams integrations. Experience with Azure AI ecosystem: Azure AI Foundry/Studio, Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, and related tools. Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or other modern Microsoft data/AI platforms preferred. Proficiency with one or more programming/scripting languages (Python, JavaScript, C#, or equivalent). Knowledge of enterprise system integration, APIs, and data flow best practices. Experience with non-Microsoft AI tools, frameworks, or platforms (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock) is a strong plus. Demonstrated success in rapidly prototyping and iterating solutions in a dynamic environment. Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly learn new tools and environments. Ability and willingness to travel up to approximately 10% of the time, both domestically and internationally.
